A farm scripting its whole farm fires them together, which means the burst itself is the tell, and spacing 39 aliases out costs the operator real scheduling effort per key. Submissions that land within 285 seconds of each other across multiple fresh identities are treated as one burst and merged into a single cluster at replay, with one identity record.
